title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E21 — A Moving Experience
Mark accepts Trey's (REGGIE McFADDEN) offer to be his roommate in an apartment building filled with beautiful women and wild parties.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E22 — Livin' A Large Lie
When Mark's grandmother (MONTROSE HAGINS) visits him, he wants to impress her with his success and asks Robin and Vanessa to pose as his servants.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E1 — Baby Love
Mark's cousin, Geneva (SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN), and her daughter, Nicole (RAVEN-SYMONÉ), move into Mark and Vanessa's house.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E2 — Slumber Party
When Vanessa and Geneva get stranded in the middle of a forest due to a broken down car, Mark is forced to chaperone Nicole's slumber party by himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E3 — School's a Drag
Mark gets in an accident with the school's drivers' education car and fears the tough, new principal, P.J. Moore, may discharge him. Sherman Hemsley and Don Cheadle guest star.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E4 — Limpin' Lizards
Nicole gets a part on the "Lester the Lizard and Crocodile Kids" show. When Mark complains about being assigned as the drivers' education teacher, PJ reassigns him to the home economics teacher position.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E5 — Free at Last
When Vanessa is not given the promotion she was promised, she takes Mark's advice to demand her rights and is promptly discharged from her job.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E6 — Father Fairest
When Earvin tells Mark that his greatest wish is to see his long-lost father, Mark locates Earvin's dad and invites him to the Halloween dance with nearly disastrous results.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E17 — Girl’s Night In
At a slumber party, Moesha and her friends reminisce (with clips from past episodes) about the past four years together.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E18 — It Takes Two
Kim’s mother, Nikki, is re-entering a journey she started 18 years ago. With Dee’s help, she will be completing her education to receive a high school diploma.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E19 — Had To Be You
An old boyfriend of Andell’s comes back into her life and proposes to her.  Moesha tries to keep Andell and Moesha’s Uncle Bernie together before it’s too late.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E20 — The Prom
Moesha’s date for the proms cancels at the last minute.  She goes unescorted and meets a handsome mysterious boy who disappears at midnight.  She tries to find him, but to no avail.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S5 E23 — Graduation Day
Michael tries to make Janet’s graduation day go smoothly.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S5 E24 — Michael Sells His Business
Michael considers selling the business.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S5 E25 — R.V. Dreams
Michael takes the family on a trip in an RV.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S5 E26 — The V Story
Janet asks Michael to get a vasectomy.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E22 — The Big Pomp And Circumstance Episode
Dee Dee starts to feel the pressure as her law school graduation fast approaches and she hasn't landed a job. Meanwhile, Mona panics when Phyllis finds a terrific apartment in her neighborhood.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E1 — The Big Gen-Why Me Episode
When Charles cuts Dee Dee off financially after she announces she wants to go back and get another degree, Dee Dee must get a 'regular' job and face life in the real world.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E2 — The Big Dollars And Sense Episode
With her new found independence in tow, Dee Dee enlists Phyllis's help in learning the value of a dollar. Mona and Spencer bump heads when Spencer goes above Mona to sign a new music act she doesn't approve of.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E3 — The Big Frozen Assets Episode
Mona's birthday goes sour when she gets an unwelcome present from her mother. While Dee Dee continues to struggle with her life direction, she is presented with a new career option.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E17 — Down in the Dumps
Mark and Vanessa think that they won the lottery but can't find their winning ticket.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E18 — Hero
Mark becomes a local hero but an awards ceremony reveals the truth. ELIHU HARRIS, the mayor of Oakland, guest stars as himself in his acting debut. DICK CLARK also appears as himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E19 — Here Comes the Groom
Mark's good advice to Earvin about romance somehow causes Earvin to elope with his new girlfriend, and Earvin's mother wants Mark to stop the couple.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E20 — The Matchmaker
Geneva's crazy Aunt Eunetta (also played by SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN) comes to visit and decides that roommates Mark and Vanessa would be the perfect couple. Nicole is upset when Tyler and his friend won't let her play in their boys-only clubhouse.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E21 — Guy's Night Out
Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E22 — High Hopes
It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E1 — Together Again
Mark, Vanessa and Geneva return to Oakland after their plans go awry. Geneva gets promoted to high school principal and wonders if she should rehire Mark.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E2 — It's A Matter Of Principal
Mark takes advantage of Geneva's position as high school principal. Vanessa refuses to return her wedding gifts, which gives Nicole and Tyler a naughty idea.

title: The Parkers
description:
S5 E1 — Til Death Do Us Part---And Make It Soon
Nikki fears for the Professor’s life.

title: The Parkers
description:
S5 E2 — Squatter's Rights
The Professor moves in with Nikki.

title: The Parkers
description:
S5 E3 — A Plot with a View
Nikki 'plots' to spend eternity with Oglevee.
